title: Voxel Adventure
subject: A first-person Minecraft player, visible as a blocky arm and hand.
attributes: A sunlit voxel landscape with grassy hills, oak trees, flowers, and square clouds.
direction: Raise a pixelated phone, then switch to a diamond sword.

prompt_timeline.prompt: In Minecraft, the player pulls out a phone
Switches to a diamond sword and slashes forward

Summons the Ender Dragon; the Ender Dragon’s appearance causes the environment to change dramatically, with thunder and snowfall at the same time. The player flies up into the sky toward the Ender Dragon, switches from the diamond sword to a staff, and casts a flashy magic spell to defeat the Ender Dragon
Then casts one more spell: Comet Azur from Elden Ring
